initial_lane_rule: Right-hand travel; southbound starts in the bank-side half of the existing 22-foot east aisle. Parking setup may use the opposing half while yielding.
scope: Seven proposed annex bays and the straight northwest approach only. Existing locked parking banks elsewhere are not certified. Local raster calibration uses owner dimensions; source PDF has no measured scale.
limitations: Steering may change while stopped; steering rate and road grades not simulated
Manual raster curb traces have approximately +/-2 pixel uncertainty
Forward ingress and reverse egress checked with the other six bays occupied
A failed search is not proof that no multipoint path exists
No revised graphic is generated before reviewing these checks

bank_fit.scale_basis: 22-foot clear east aisle and 22-foot clear south connecting aisle, separately calibrated axes

annex_turning.entry: Forward from proper southbound lane, bounded-curvature lateral setup while yielding, turn, then straight into bay
annex_turning.exit: Reverse the checked trajectory to the original proper lane; then proceed forward along the retained aisle
